entry.title: New: RES26-261 (Honolulu) — INTRO
entry.content:
URGING THE HAWAIIAN ELECTRIC COMPANY, INC., IN COORDINATION WITH THE HAWAIʻI PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AND THE DEPARTMENT OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT, TO DEVELOP A PROGRAM TO DISTRIBUTE PORTABLE GENERATORS AND PORTABLE BATTERY POWER STATIONS TO ELIGIBLE RESIDENTS BEFORE A STORM WHEN PROLONGED POWER OUTAGES ARE ANTICIPATED.

Latest action: Introduced.
